_provenance: Extracted-tier (FDA press release) records used to test merge.ts.
The `verified` half of each pair is REAL, captured openFDA data — see
openfda-enforcement.json and openfda-merge-partners.json — and is run through
the real normalizeOpenFda in the tests.
The records BELOW are RECONSTRUCTED, not captured, and that is deliberate:
as of 2026-08-30 no genuine cross-source duplicate exists in live data. The
windows are disjoint by construction. openFDA's report_date lags the recall
initiation date by a median of 69 days (min 14, max 196), so the openFDA
30-day window holds recalls initiated January-July while the RSS 30-day
window holds announcements from August. A recall's two rows are therefore
almost never in-window at the same moment.
Each record below is built from the real openFDA row for the SAME recall,
rephrased the way an FDA press release states it (shorter product name, brand
present, no classification, prose fields empty pending step 7) and dated to
